verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a comprehensive, documented public API Reference (datadog-docs-24) covering the platform's functionality, and this is corroborated by a probe confirming documentation exists (though a standard OpenAPI spec file returned 404 at common paths). This is a well-established, widely-used API used to programmatically drive nearly all Datadog features. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of API usage/reliability, and a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard paths).
